scene.head: tilt
scene.placeText: the steaming valve room at the foot of the six great riveted brass hot-water tanks under the glass dome on the wooded hill above her steam city on a frosty morning — polished pipes and pressure gauges along the walls, white steam curling around her and the glass dome glowing like a pearl overhead
scene.ownProp: a long polished brass valve key for the city's hot-water mains, its handle curled like a rising plume of steam
scene.outfit: a hot-water keeper look fitted to her body — one big brass gauntlet of valve wheels and coiled hot-water pipes covering her whole right arm, a sleeveless fitted waistcoat-corset with the round yoke pattern of an Icelandic wool sweater around its neckline, high-waisted shorts, a comb of six tiny brass tanks under a little glass dome between her hair loops and laced ankle boots
scene.scene: she is the hot-water keeper of the pearl dome, down on one knee at the great brass valve, both hands on her long valve key as she turns it to send warm water from the tanks out to every house in the city
